Usage: payway-sdk [options] [command]

CLI for the ABA PayWay TypeScript SDK

Setup:
  init                     Initialize PayWay integration in the current project
  doctor                   Validate environment configuration and connectivity
  config                   Display loaded configuration and validate environment
                           variables
  profiles                 Manage saved sandbox and production credential
                           profiles
  onboard                  Guided setup: scan config, configure an inference
                           provider + PayWay profile, verify readiness
  completions              Emit a shell completion script for payway-sdk
                           (derived from the live command registry)
Payments:
  generate-qr              Generate a QR code (online via PayWay API or offline)
  request-qr               Create a Soundbox QR (payments/request-qr) — amount
                           optional for on-device keypad entry; spec-derived
                           contract, not yet live-verified
  generate-checkout        Create a PayWay checkout and optionally save its QR
                           as a PNG
  cof                      Credentials-on-file: link account/card, charge, and
                           renew/inspect/remove tokens
  checkout-form            Generate the hosted-checkout HTML form (local
                           signing, no API call)
  payment-link             Create and inspect PayWay payment links (requires RSA
                           credentials)
  setup-webhook            Start a local webhook listener for PayWay callbacks
  webhook                  Local webhook workbench: verify, trigger, resend
                           captured callbacks
Transactions:
  check-transaction        Check the payment status of a transaction (rate
                           limit: 600/s)
  poll-transaction         Poll a transaction until it reaches a terminal status
                           (APPROVED, DECLINED, CANCELLED, REFUNDED)
  transaction-detail       Get full detail for one transaction (strict rate
                           limit: 10/min)
  transaction-list         List transactions in a time window (rate limit:
                           50/min; defaults to today). Dates are GATEWAY time
                           UTC+7 — a UTC/local-derived window silently returns 0
                           rows.
  get-transactions-by-ref  Get up to 50 transactions by merchant reference
                           (Customer Module reconciliation: use the portal
                           Customer ID as the reference)
  close-transaction        Void/close an open transaction before it is paid
  tx-batch                 Run one transaction operation (close | check |
                           detail) over a set of IDs
Money-out:
  refund                   Refund a captured transaction (pre-flight balance
                           check against transaction-detail)
  payout                   Send a payout / split-payout to one or more
                           whitelisted beneficiary accounts
  pre-auth                 Complete, complete-with-payout, or cancel a PayWay
                           pre-authorization
  beneficiary              Manage payout beneficiary whitelist accounts
                           (requires RSA key)
  self-activation          Merchant self-activation via partner credentials
                           (new-merchant, credential-info, mc-info) —
                           spec-derived, not live-verified
Reference:
  docs                     Read the built-in PayWay knowledge base (guides,
                           sandbox learnings, error codes) — offline
  status                   Display payment status codes and refund error codes
                           reference
  explain                  Decode a PayWay error/status code (e.g. explain
                           PTL36, explain 49). No credentials needed.
  validate                 Validate a refund amount or transaction ID locally
  exchange-rate            Fetch the current USD/KHR exchange rate from PayWay
  sandbox-beneficiaries    List seeded sandbox beneficiary accounts and test
                           MIDs for payout testing (SANDBOX ONLY)
  sandbox-test-cards       List ABA sandbox test cards for hosted card-checkout
                           testing (SANDBOX ONLY)
Agent & skills:
  ask                      Ask the PayWay agent to perform a request (single
                           shot)
  agent                    Agentic PayWay CLI (REPL when run without a
                           subcommand)
  skills                   Manage AI skill guides for coding agents
  demo                     Run a credential-free simulated payment journey on
                           localhost
  test                     Run the PayWay sandbox test suite
  mcp                      Serve the PayWay tool catalog as an MCP stdio server
                           (read-only by default; --allow-mutations opts in)
  session                  Interactive command-first shell over the CLI (:use
                           <tran-id> sticks a transaction id; :help for
                           directives)
Other:
  credential-info          Inquire encrypted merchant credential details by
                           register_ref (get-mc-credential-info)
  journal                  Query the local transaction journal (enable recording
                           with --journal or PAYWAY_JOURNAL=1)
  mc-info                  Fetch merchant API info (accounts, payment methods)
                           by merchant key (get-mc-info)
  new-merchant             Register a merchant via online-self-activation
                           (partner credentials; returns the onboarding form URL
                           + session token)

Options:
  -V, --version                       output the version number
  --profile <name>                    Use a saved credential profile for this
                                      command
  --no-color                          Disable ANSI colors in output
  --journal                           Force the transaction journal on (<data
                                      root>/journal.jsonl; ON by default for API
                                      commands)
  --no-journal                        Disable the transaction journal for this
                                      invocation
  -h, --help                          display help for command

Journey examples:
  $ payway-sdk init && payway-sdk doctor --live   set up, then prove a real sandbox round-trip
  $ payway-sdk generate-qr -a 5.00                create QR (scans right in your terminal) and poll until paid
  $ payway-sdk check-transaction -t <id>          one-shot status check
  $ payway-sdk poll-transaction -t <id> --json    watch a transaction until terminal status (agent-friendly)
  $ payway-sdk transaction-list                   today's transactions
  $ payway-sdk refund -t <id> -a 2.00             partial refund with pre-flight balance check
  $ payway-sdk explain PTL36                      decode any PayWay error code

Exit codes: 0 success · 1 input/validation · 2 PayWay API failure · 3 network/timeout/rate-limit.

Usage: payway-sdk check-transaction [options]

Check the payment status of a transaction (rate limit: 600/s)

Options:
  -t, --transaction-id <id>  Transaction ID
  --json                     Print the raw JSON response
  -h, --help                 display help for command

Usage: payway-sdk init [options]

Initialize PayWay integration in the current project

Options:
  --mode <mode>          Setup path: demo or sandbox (default: "sandbox")
  --template <template>  Starter: framework or first-payment (default:
                         "framework")
  -h, --help             display help for command

First-payment path:
  First payment: use --mode sandbox --template first-payment, then doctor --route online-qr.
